title: Keel AgentExecutor (keel/v1alpha1)
description: kind: AgentExecutor — spec section 14.1/section 14.8: HOW and WHERE a logical Agent runs. A command template (built from structured args, never by concatenating shell with model content, section 14.8). The `{prompt}` placeholder receives the AgentRequest prompt via argument; the material under analysis is delivered delimited as data (section 13.2), never as instructions.

command.description: argv; the token '{prompt}' (if present) is replaced by the request prompt. The AgentRequest JSON is also sent on stdin.
